title: APETx4, a Novel Sea Anemone Toxin and a Modulator of the Cancer-Relevant Potassium Channel KV10.1
summary: Source-reviewed rework extracted APETx4 ion-channel and cell-line activity evidence, reconciled DRAMP rows, and replaced the framework-test adjudication with paper-specific cautions.
adjudication_summary: The paper is publication-grade for obtainable local material with cautions: APETx4 is source-supported as a KV10.1/hEag1 inhibitor and cytotoxic/proapoptotic cell-line modulator, while the DRAMP antimicrobial label and exact supplemental graph point values are not supported as primary table rows.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA package, linked DRAMP rows, and supplementary ZIP were opened. Supplement Figure S5/S6 PDFs are graphical and do not expose exact per-timepoint data tables.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains separate from review status: XML/PDF/OA assets and linked DRAMP rows are present; supplementary ZIP contains figure PDFs but no structured supplemental tables.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Required final JSON artifacts, status vocabulary, source locators, and review provenance are present after rework.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DRAMP literature and experiment rows are source-verified; the DRAMP antimicrobial activity label is preserved as source_conflict because no primary antimicrobial assay appears in the local paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Seven source-supported activity/toxicity rows were extracted. Tables 1 and 2 were adjudicated as cell-line metadata/culture tables, while activity values and trends come from Results text, main figures, and supplemental figure PDFs.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are limited to direct voltage-clamp channel modulation and indirect cell-line phenotypes; no antimicrobial or direct membrane-lytic mechanism is claimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The open rework ticket is resolved for obtainable local material; remaining limitations are nonblocking cautions rather than missing owner-layer work.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP labels APETx4 as antimicrobial, but the local primary paper supports KV10.1/channel and anticancer cell-line assays, not antimicrobial MIC/MBC/hemolysis rows.
Supplement Figure S5/S6 PDFs provide plotted/image evidence but no embedded exact data table; exact curve point values are not fabricated.
The primary paper reports cytotoxic/proapoptotic effects but does not identify the exact non-KV10.1 cellular target.

tools_attempted: manual image review of rendered supplemental figures
unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Figure S5/S6 are graphical PDFs with plotted curves/images and captions but no embedded data table; exact per-timepoint confluency or green-object-count values are not locally recoverable without unsafe manual digitization.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Qualitative concentration-response, tested concentrations, assay families, targets, and prose-supported trends are recorded; exact supplemental curve point values are not claimed.
